definitions.explanation: The ratio of a building's total floor area (summed over all stories) to the area of the plot, expressed as a percentage. A zoning limit that effectively controls how tall or dense a building may be.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{容積率|ようせきりつ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This area has a high floor area ratio.

examples.japanese: {容積率|ようせきりつ}が{大|おお}きいほど、{高|たか}い{建物|たてもの}が{建|た}てられる。
examples.english: The larger the floor area ratio, the taller a building you can put up.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}は{容積率|ようせきりつ}が{緩和|かんわ}され、{高層|こうそう}マンションが{次々|つぎつぎ}と{建|た}った。
examples.english: The floor area ratio was relaxed in front of the station, and high-rise condominiums went up one after another.

notes:
A real-estate and zoning term. Together with {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ} (building coverage ratio), it governs how much can be built on a lot: coverage ratio limits the footprint, floor area ratio limits total floor space.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容積率|ようせきりつ}が{高|たか}い: to have a high floor area ratio
- {容積率|ようせきりつ}の{緩和|かんわ}: relaxation of the floor area ratio
- {容積率|ようせきりつ}{二百|にひゃく}パーセント: a floor area ratio of 200%

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}: building coverage ratio — the footprint limit, not total floor area
